Actions: Once per turn, place some your dice on an action space, one die per square. Typically, the lowest value die you place indicates how many times you may take the action, or how much you get. You may place dice on any unoccupied action space. You may place dice on an occupied blue action space by paying as many coins as the die value of the lowest die you place. You may not place dice on an occupied blue space that already holds your colour of dice. You may not place dice on a brown occupied space. Bonus actions: Take 3 coins using a die (value does not matter) Buy a black die (only once per turn) for 3 camels Bump a die +1/-1 for 2 camels Re-roll a die for 1 camel Fulfill a contract by returning the required goods Extra end of game points: 1 VP for every 10 coins left over 7 VP to player with most contracts Score VP from Beijing, depends on position in Beijing Score 1 VP for every 2 resources if you have a trading post in Beijing Expert variant: Distribution of City Bonuses: Randomized Distribution of Characters: Randomly shuffle playercount +1, choose one, starting from last player. Distribution of Goal Cards: Deal 4 choose 2 to keep. [Rating: 1/10] Beautiful components, evoking theme, mid-light weight and great variability but nothing new mechanically, uneven random secret objectives, under compensated low rolls, snowballing, virtual dead end, widely unbalanced characters and foreseeable winner.

[Rating: 1/10] Mehhh,  Typical euro cube pushing point salad...  This game is a bunch of mechanics thrown together that feels soulless at best. It is also too long for what it is... To add to the insult, the variable characters powers seems unbalanced as hell. Not properly play-tested !  There's absolutely nothing new here... Been there, done that... next...

[Rating: 1/10] I genuinely struggle to understand why this game is liked. It is not even a game in my opinion, it is a set of mediocre choices where the margins between them are so small that it actively saps all fun from board games. Shockingly bad!

[Rating: 1/10] This is a $##$$$#@!@##$%% frustrating game.  Game I played, the first player at the start of the game was start player the entire game. I started the game as last player and no strategizing allowed me to ever move away from last place. Not even playing one dice every turn .  Everyone always bought a black dice on their turn.  This person always had both black dice.  It was easy for this player to plan her moves so she would be the last to travel.

[Rating: 1/10] El horror, el horror, el horror. Una basura de eurogamer diseñado con el ojo del culo. Aburrido y absurdo hasta el vómito. 0% temático y 0% divertido. Una mierda peluda.

[Rating: 1/10] I came here, because of all the people rating mature themed games like KD:M or Hate with a 1, just because of their mature theme. This games theme is boring!

[Rating: 1/10] Dull min/max look for the optimal move while abusing the advantages of your starting player power euro.

[Rating: 1/10] I was trying to read rules pdf in preparation for a BGA game. I find the disconnect between theme and mechanics just too strong in this case. I did try discussing it on BGG. Perhaps unsurprisingly that was an unpleasant experience and I never want to go near this game again.
